name: Telehealth by SimplePractice
one_liner: Built-in HIPAA-compliant video telehealth seamlessly integrated with SimplePractice EHR, featuring one-click sessions, virtual waiting rooms, and screen sharing.

short_description: HIPAA-compliant video telehealth built into SimplePractice, offering seamless scheduling, documentation, and billing integration for mental health practices.
long_description: Telehealth by SimplePractice is the integrated video conferencing feature within SimplePractice, the leading practice management platform for mental health professionals. Unlike standalone telehealth platforms, SimplePractice Telehealth is deeply integrated with scheduling, documentation, and billing workflows, allowing clinicians to start video sessions with one click from their calendar, take notes during sessions, and bill directly without switching tools. The platform includes HD video, virtual waiting rooms where clients see a calming animation before sessions, screen sharing for psychoeducation materials, and text chat during sessions. Patients join via a link in their appointment reminder without downloading any app. SimplePractice Telehealth is HIPAA compliant with a BAA included in all plans that feature telehealth. The platform works on desktop browsers and offers mobile apps for both iOS and Android, enabling providers to see clients from anywhere. Mental health-specific features include integration with Wiley treatment planners and documentation templates designed for therapy notes.
patient_summary: HIPAA-compliant video telehealth built into SimplePractice, offering seamless scheduling, documentation, and billing integration for mental health practices.

pricing.notes: Telehealth requires Essential or Plus plan ($69+/month). 30-day free trial available. Group practice pricing available.

privacy.notes: BAA included with all plans. HIPAA-compliant data handling throughout platform.

faqs.q: Is SimplePractice Telehealth included with my subscription?
faqs.a: Telehealth is included with Essential ($69/month) and Plus ($99/month) plans. The Starter plan ($29/month) does not include telehealth. All plans with telehealth include unlimited video sessions.

faqs.q: Do clients need to download an app for SimplePractice Telehealth?
faqs.a: No, clients can join via web browser on any device by clicking the link in their appointment reminder. However, SimplePractice also offers client mobile apps for iOS and Android if patients prefer an app experience.

faqs.q: Can I use SimplePractice Telehealth for group therapy?
faqs.a: Yes, SimplePractice Telehealth supports up to 6 participants per session, making it suitable for couples therapy, family sessions, and small therapy groups. Larger group sessions would require a different platform.

faqs.q: How does SimplePractice Telehealth compare to using Zoom?
faqs.a: SimplePractice Telehealth is deeply integrated with your EHR, so you start sessions from your calendar, take notes during sessions, and bill without switching tools. Zoom offers more advanced features like breakout rooms and session recording, but requires separate integration setup.
